executor: bash -c; cwd is explicit for each command; exit status written to a .rc file then read

features.native_workspace: default (empty crate default feature sets; dependencies retain manifest-selected features)
features.python_wheel: extension-module plus pyo3 abi3-py38 from manifest
features.rust_crate: source package verified with default features

host_and_ambient_environment: versions.txt and node24-versions.txt; shared host and registries, separate source/build directories; no claim of hermetic or offline environments

commands.name: a-clean
commands.command: export PATH=/home/monkey/bin:/home/monkey/scratch/reproinputs/node-tool/node_modules/.bin:$PATH; export RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=1.96.1; git rev-parse HEAD && git status --porcelain

commands.name: a-crate
commands.command: export PATH=/home/monkey/bin:/home/monkey/scratch/reproinputs/node-tool/node_modules/.bin:$PATH; export RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=1.96.1; cargo package -p safemesh-crdt --locked

commands.name: a-native
commands.command: export PATH=/home/monkey/bin:/home/monkey/scratch/reproinputs/node-tool/node_modules/.bin:$PATH; export RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=1.96.1; cargo build --workspace --release --locked --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu

commands.name: a-wheel
commands.command: export PATH=/home/monkey/bin:/home/monkey/scratch/reproinputs/node-tool/node_modules/.bin:$PATH; export RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=1.96.1; maturin build --release --locked --features extension-module --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --out /home/monkey/scratch/reproinputs/artifacts-a/wheels

commands.name: a-wasm-bundler
commands.command: export PATH=/home/monkey/bin:/home/monkey/scratch/reproinputs/node-tool/node_modules/.bin:$PATH; export RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=1.96.1; wasm-pack build rust/crates/safemesh-wasm --target bundler --out-dir /home/monkey/scratch/reproinputs/artifacts-a/wasm-bundler --release -- --locked

commands.name: a-wasm-node
commands.command: export PATH=/home/monkey/bin:/home/monkey/scratch/reproinputs/node-tool/node_modules/.bin:$PATH; export RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=1.96.1; wasm-pack build rust/crates/safemesh-wasm --target nodejs --out-dir /home/monkey/scratch/reproinputs/artifacts-a/wasm-node --release -- --locked

commands.name: a-npm-node
commands.command: export PATH=/home/monkey/bin:/home/monkey/scratch/reproinputs/node-tool/node_modules/.bin:$PATH; export RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=1.96.1; mkdir -p /home/monkey/scratch/reproinputs/artifacts-a/node-tar && npm pack /home/monkey/scratch/reproinputs/artifacts-a/wasm-node --pack-destination /home/monkey/scratch/reproinputs/artifacts-a/node-tar
